product.name: Slim Fit Easy-iron Shirt
product.description: Slim-fit, easy-iron shirt in woven fabric with a fitted silhouette. Turn-down collar, classic button placket, and a yoke at back. Long sleeves, sleeve placket with link button, and adjustable cuffs with buttons. Gently rounded hem.
